algorithm: {The "Quantum-inspired" algorithm combines random search with a novel selection strategy inspired by quantum measurement to efficiently explore the 5-dimensional Sphere function and find its global minimum.}

{The proposed algorithm is a simplified version of the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) that minimizes the 5-dimensional Sphere function by iteratively sampling and adapting to the optimal step size in each dimension, guided by the current best solution found so far.}
{ **A hybrid optimization algorithm that combines a simple evolutionary strategy with local search refinement** }
